AF_XDP networking and packet routing between IPv4 and tango.

# Purpose
This document describes the `net` tile, which handles network I/O for Firedancer by translating between IPv4 traffic and the `tango` messaging system. It explains how the tile uses Linux AF_XDP, XDP modes, UMEM buffers, and ring buffers to move packets through RX and TX paths with low software overhead. The content also defines the persistent and ephemeral kernel setup, the packet ownership lifecycle, and the topology used to connect the net tile to app tiles. It further covers loopback handling, development support with network namespaces and `fddev pktgen`, and the main limits and security rules that apply to the current design.
